name: OpenClaw Fleet by Leassh
description: SSH fleet monitoring for OpenClaw by Leassh — standalone binary or server mode against a Leassh server.

mode.description: standalone spawns the bundled binary; server pairs with a Leassh server (recommended when one runs on your LAN)

serverUrl.description: Server mode: Leassh server base URL, e.g. http://192.168.1.127:8790

apiToken.description: Server mode: openclaw-scope API token minted on the Leassh server
